text:
Alex P: Heads up — our AWS RI & SavingsPlans report just flagged a coverage mismatch for GPU families. A bunch of p4d and a100 commitments are under 70% utilization for the last 30d. We have an expiry window in ~45 days.
Maria S: Oof. Do we have the list of exact reservations and their tenancy/zone constraints? Some were regional, some zonal.
Devon K: I pulled the inventory earlier. Short summary in the dashboard: https://dash.internal/reports/ri-usage (see summary table). Most of the low-util ones are p4d.24xlarge regional RIs purchased 2yrs ago, and a smaller set of a100 zonal RIs that can't be moved cross-region.
Samir: Can we convert to Savings Plans or exchange/sell the zonal ones? I thought AWS lets you modify regional RIs but zonal are sticky.
June L: Zonal RIs can be sold on the RI Marketplace but only for instance types within the same region and only if they're not part of a tenancy restriction. We should check tag ownership and whether any Dedicated hosts are involved.
ops-bot: Automated note: Last 30d utilization by family -> p4d: 62%, a100: 57%, g5: 84%. RI coverage delta vs on-demand: -18% for p4d.
Maria S: Given the numbers, my prioritization: 1) try to rehome workloads to use p4d instances (where latency/cost matters) 2) for the persistent underutilized zonal a100s, evaluate marketplace listing 3) avoid blind renewal of 3yr convertible RIs.
Devon K: Agreed. Also consider short-term cushion using Dedicated capacity (our Redwood Dedicated pools) for bursty training while we clean up RIs. That avoids buying more long-term commitments.
Samir: For conversion -> SavingsPlans: we need to model cost upsides. I'll run a quick projection script that compares current RI amortized cost vs 1y and 3y Savings Plans for GPU-weighted usage.
Samir: Here's the quick command I'm running (local):
```bash
python infra/tools/ri_analysis.py --start 2025-12-01 --end 2026-02-28 --group-by family,region --output /tmp/ri-proj.csv
```
Maria S: Make sure the script accounts for machine-type replacements (p4d -> p5 family pricing delta) and for per-token inference jobs where we can shift to cheaper quantized variants on g5s.
Devon K: Also remember transfer/egress patterns. If we sell zonal RIs and later need capacity in that AZ, we might pay a big premium. Flagging that as a risk.
ops-bot: Billing snippet for context: 
```
SavingsPlans Utilization: 68%
SavingsPlans Coverage: 52%
ReservedInstances Utilization (weighted): 64%
Upcoming expiries: 2026-05-30 (4 x p4d regional), 2026-06-03 (2 x a100 zonal)
```
June L: Proposal: split the plan: sell the 2 a100 zonal RIs on marketplace (low friction), convert 2 of the p4d regionals into convertible RIs/SavingsPlan trade if AWS allows, and place a 6-month Reserved capacity on Dedicated for buffer. We can present cost delta to finance.
Alex P: Sounds reasonable. Can someone prepare a short decision matrix (cost delta, migration risk, operational friction, timeline) — annotate each RI row. If it's >$50k annual savings we can auto-approve; otherwise route to finance.
Samir: I'll produce the decision matrix and attach the CSV. Target: draft by EOD Thursday.
Maria S: I'll map services to specific RI tags so we know owner signoff.
Devon K: I'll run the marketplace price history for the a100s and capture expected time-to-sell.
ops-bot: Action items logged: 1) Samir -> decision matrix (due EOD Thu) 2) Maria -> tag/service mapping (due Tue) 3) Devon -> marketplace pricing (due Wed) 4) Ops -> block a 6-month Dedicated buffer (pending cost OK).
billing-bot: FYI finance slack channel updated with projected numbers (link: https://finance.internal/ri-proposals/1761234567).
Alex P: Great — let's sync in the infra weekly tomorrow 10:30 and decide final path before the earliest expiry. :thumbsup:
